top_signals.title: Gold Extends Decline as Inflation Risks Lift Fed Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold extended a three-day decline as escalating attacks in the Middle East and concerns about inflation ratcheted up bets on interest rate hikes and pushed bond yields higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bessent on China's G20 Dissent, Japan, and Canada Spat
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said China prevented the Group of 20 from issuing a joint communique due to a dispute over its giant trade surplus, while commenting on US trade and financial relations with Japan and Canada. Watch the highlights from his press conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. Shale Producers Lose Bid to Kill Oil Price-Fixing Case
top_signals.summary: A federal judge has allowed antitrust lawsuits accusing some of the biggest U.S. shale producers of coordinating production cuts to keep oil and fuel prices higher to proceed. U.S. District Judge Matthew Garcia in New Mexico rejected efforts by Diamondback Energy, Occidental Petroleum and other producers to dismiss the consolidated litigation. The lawsuits, filed beginning in 2024, allege that producers restrained shale output and ultimately pushed up prices for crude oil, gasoline, diesel and heating oil. top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Binance expands TradFi push with options on 1,000 US stocks, ETFs
top_signals.summary: The launch gives eligible non-US users access to physically settled options on more than 1,000 US stocks and ETFs through a single Binance account.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Fish-fruit pairings catching on as novel way to spur demand
top_signals.summary: With fish consumption declining, particularly among younger people, one fish market official hopes pairing fish with fruit will give dishes a "sense of novelty and visual flair."
